sources.snippet: Pre-exported ONNX models and a lightweight inference CLI for CIGPose (67.5 Whole AP on COCO-WholeBody). CIGPose by 53mins. Model weights come from the original training pipeline built on MMPose. This repo is just the ONNX conversion and inference wrapper.

sources.title: namas191297/cigpose-onnx | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The cigpose-onnx repository provides a high-performance, lightweight implementation of the CIGPose (Causal Intervention Graph Pose) model using ONNX Runtime. It is designed for production-grade whole-body pose estimation without the heavy dependency stack of PyTorch or MMPose.

sources.title: Model Zoo & Selection Guide | namas191297/cigpose-onnx | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the available pre-trained ONNX models for the CIGPose pipeline. CIGPose (Causal Intervention Graph Pose) is a top-down pose estimation framework that utilizes causal inference to mitigate visual context confounding, resulting in higher accuracy under occlusion and complex backgrounds.
